description: Checks how modules are wired to a microcontroller board, pin by pin, with PCBBrew's catalogue data (no AI): missing or unknown pins, pins not on the headers, wrong supply (3.3 V module on 5 V), 5 V signals into non 5 V tolerant GPIOs, analog outputs on non-ADC pins, boot/strapping pins, pins used twice, invalid I2C pins (Arduino A4/A5, RP2040 pairs) and I2C address conflicts. Board and module ids come from search_parts; board pins by their header name (GPIO4, D7, A0, GP15, 3V3, 5V, GND).

board.description: board id, e.g. ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, Arduino-Nano, Raspberry-Pi-Pico

id.description: your name for it, e.g. U1

type.description: module id from search_parts, e.g. bme280

name: check_wiring
title: Check module wiring
